newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines lowers special series T-bill rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippines lowers special series T-bill rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it had reduced the 78-day special series Treasury bill rate to 11.0 percent.
The rate cut came a day after the benchmark three-month bill rate fell to 11.33 percent from 11.495 percent.
On Monday, the comparable 79-day T-bill rate was 11.25 percent.
The Central Bank is also offering 85-day bills at 11.0 percent.
The Central Bank withdrew its 58-day and 359-day bills.
